feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is claimed for it. The candidate is the iteration 5 design (best raced, score 160.41) with one field changed: controller.ki from 0.05 to 0.10. It is valid and isolates the integral lever, which has not been tested. Iteration 7 (line_loss search_left, score 159.12) changed nothing measurable against iteration 5 (oval, s-bend and slalom metrics matched to about 0.001 m), so line-loss direction is exhausted. Iteration 4 (kp 3.0, score 83.5) showed steering gain is exhausted, and iteration 6 (kd 0.45, score 143.1) pushed oval steering_oscillation to 0.333 and raised max_error on the oval and slalom. Every run since iteration 2 has ended off_track with max_error at 0.060 to 0.063 m against the 0.06 m limit, so the remaining question is whether a steady bias is responsible. Approval is justified because this is the best design raced so far, the change is one field, and a revision round would cost two of the three remaining action runs for little extra information. Next step, depending on the race: if max_error falls below about 0.060 m on the oval and slalom, or line_loss_events drop on the s-bend, keep ki 0.10 and consider base_speed 1.5 as the next single change only if completion_time is limiting. If max_error rises above the iteration 5 values (0.0604 oval, 0.0623 s-bend, 0.0616 slalom), or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.3 on any track, revert ki to 0.05 and stop changing gains. If max_error and line_loss_events are both unchanged, the binding limit is likely geometry or sensor resolution, so test a single sensor-spacing change in the next iteration.
requested_changes: If max_error falls below about 0.060 m on the oval and slalom and steering_oscillation stays below 0.3: keep controller.ki 0.10 and test controller.base_speed 1.5 as the only change, but only if completion_time is limiting on any track (iteration 5 oval finish at 1.89 s shows speed is adequate there).

If max_error rises above the iteration 5 values (0.0604 oval, 0.0623 s-bend, 0.0616 slalom) or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.3 on any track: revert controller.ki to 0.05, since iteration 6 showed oscillation rising with added damping and gain changes have already been exhausted.

If max_error and line_loss_events are both unchanged from iteration 5 with ki 0.10: keep ki 0.10 and test one geometry change, such as moving the outer sensors (geometry.sensor_positions x = plus or minus 0.020 m) to widen the signal span, since sensor_size is already at its maximum 0.016 and line-loss direction gave no change in iterations 5 and 7.
